description: Source code for the ColumnarArray class in Apache Spark, representing an array abstraction within the vectorized columnar data processing framework.

classes.name: ColumnarArray
classes.description: A class representing a columnar array in Spark's vectorized execution engine, providing methods to access and manipulate array data efficiently.

methods.name: numElements
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the array.

methods.name: setNullBits
methods.description: Sets null bits in the UnsafeArrayData based on nulls in the underlying data.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of the array data, handling different data types appropriately.

methods.name: toBooleanArray
methods.description: Converts the array data to a boolean array.

methods.name: toByteArray
methods.description: Converts the array data to a byte array.

methods.name: toShortArray
methods.description: Converts the array data to a short array.

methods.name: toIntArray
methods.description: Converts the array data to an int array.

methods.name: toLongArray
methods.description: Converts the array data to a long array.

methods.name: toFloatArray
methods.description: Converts the array data to a float array.

methods.name: toDoubleArray
methods.description: Converts the array data to a double array.

methods.name: array
methods.description: Returns the array elements as an Object[]; note this is expensive.

methods.name: isNullAt
methods.description: Checks if the element at the given position is null.

methods.name: getBoolean
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean element at the specified position.

methods.name: getByte
methods.description: Retrieves a byte element at the specified position.

methods.name: getShort
methods.description: Retrieves a short element at the specified position.

methods.name: getInt
methods.description: Retrieves an int element at the specified position.

methods.name: getLong
methods.description: Retrieves a long element at the specified position.

methods.name: getFloat
methods.description: Retrieves a float element at the specified position.

methods.name: getDouble
methods.description: Retrieves a double element at the specified position.

methods.name: getDecimal
methods.description: Retrieves a Decimal value at the specified position.

methods.name: getUTF8String
methods.description: Retrieves a UTF8String at the specified position.

methods.name: getBinary
methods.description: Retrieves binary data at the specified position.

methods.name: getGeography
methods.description: Retrieves a GeographyVal at the specified position.

methods.name: getGeometry
methods.description: Retrieves a GeometryVal at the specified position.

methods.name: getInterval
methods.description: Retrieves a CalendarInterval at the specified position.

methods.name: getVariant
methods.description: Retrieves a VariantVal at the specified position.

methods.name: getStruct
methods.description: Retrieves a struct (ColumnarRow) at the specified position.

methods.name: getArray
methods.description: Retrieves a nested ColumnarArray at the specified position.

methods.name: getMap
methods.description: Retrieves a ColumnarMap at the specified position.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Generic method to retrieve data based on DataType.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Method to update an element; not supported in this class.

methods.name: setNullAt
methods.description: Method to set an element to null; not supported in this class.
